findings.explanation: format_cents never sets the sign. `sign` stays "" and abs(cents) is used, so -123456 returns "1,234.56" instead of "-1,234.56". This fails the third acceptance criterion. The fix is to set sign = "-" when cents < 0.

There is no test for negative amounts, so the missing leading '-' goes undetected. Add a test that asserts format_cents(-123456) == "-1,234.56". A small negative such as -5 -> "-0.05" would also be worth covering.
